Which country has the largest population in the world?

What is the longest river in the world?
The longest river in the world is the **Amazon River**. It flows through South America and is one of the most significant rivers in the world. Its length is approximately **6,400 kilometers**.
What is the tallest mountain on Earth?
The tallest mountain on Earth is **Mount Everest**, located in the Himalayas. It stands at approximately **8,848 meters (28,894 feet)** above sea level and is the highest peak in the world.

The largest ocean is the **Pacific Ocean**. It covers approximately **14.7 million square kilometers** and is the largest among all the oceans.

Plants absorb **carbon dioxide (CO₂)** from the air through their stomata, which are small openings on the leaves. This process is part of the **carbon cycle**, where CO₂ is released back into the atmosphere when plants die or are burned.

What force pulls objects toward the Earth?

The force that pulls objects toward the Earth is **gravity**. Gravity is a fundamental force in physics that acts between any two masses, and it attracts objects with mass toward the center of the Earth.
